title: feat(wt1iff2): wt1 is not equivalent to positive two-site coverage
science: Refutes a proposed equivalence and states the correct characterization in prose: cov2>0 is NOT equivalent to wt1=1 (N_wt1=16, N_pos=14, N_both=14; counterexamples (1,0,0,0,0) and (1,1,0,0,0) stall at halt 10). One-way implication wt1=0 => cov2=0 holds, and the note states positive coverage needs wt1=1 AND at least one of adj2/vertex3/mixed3 - the exact selector later formalized by #6494.
verdict_pair: reverse=none face=none (f_cut equivalence census; no (reverse,face) pair stated)
